scientific_integrity: Exact analytic classification and rational second-moment proof, with directly replayable finite sliding-window checks; no claims of human or independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: One-sided maximum-one-factor profiles of indexed binary words with four ones; not complete factor-Parikh set equivalence; no extrapolation to other Hamming weights. Historical equivalence in unindexed literature is possible.
title: Exact fiber-size spectrum of four-one binary prefix-normal profiles
